run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of triangles from n non-collinear points in a plane
test_f_gold: test f_gold with sample inputs to verify triangle count calculations for various n values
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which calculates combinations of 3 points from n using the formula n*(n-1)*(n-2)//6
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the combinatorial approach for counting triangles from n points
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to add input validation for negative or non-integer n values
